title: SciAtlas：面向自动化科学研究的超大规模知识图谱
summary: SciAtlas是一个跨学科、异构的学术资源知识图谱，整合了4300万篇论文、1.57亿实体和30亿三元组，旨在解决学术信息爆炸和跨学科整合难题。它采用神经符号检索算法，实现从语义匹配到确定性关联发现的转变，为AI代理提供结构化拓扑认知基础，降低推理成本，支持文献综述、趋势综合、创意定位等自动化科研全流程。
summary_en: SciAtlas is a large-scale, multi-disciplinary knowledge graph integrating 43M papers, 157M entities, and 3B triplets to address information explosion in academia. It uses a neuro-symbolic retrieval algorithm for deterministic association discovery, providing AI agents with structured topological cognition to reduce reasoning costs and empower automated scientific research.
